import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
import lap
wt = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q'], cwd=wt, capture_output=True)
open(os.path.join(wt, 'app.py'), 'w').write('A\nB\nC\n')
ok, d, _ = lap.apply_mutations([{'file': 'app.py', 'find': 'A\nB\n', 'replace': 'X\n'}], wt)
out = open(os.path.join(wt, 'app.py')).read()
assert out == 'X\nC\n', out
print('K3-RED-GREEN')
